about_h2: About Little Ts Towing and Auto Recycling
about_p1: This is one of the friendliest men & tow workers I have ever used for towing my vehicles I called him early in the morning he had something to do, but he still came and helped me out. He's just a one man show instead of these other companies that have a lot of people, but he doesn't a great job doing what he does. He also does key fobs now which is very helpful for a lot of people. I would recommend him to everyone.
about_p2: called Little T’s towing in a panic- I had locked the keys in my car with the only car seat I had in it, and I was needing to pick up the baby from daycare in just a few hours. He came right out with everything needed and got us in within minutes! He was such a friendly guy, very professional and saved the day for us! Highly recommended for all your towing and even accidental needs!

reviews.author: Pastor Sheryl
reviews.text: Awesome and Great service. Helped me out of tire catastrophe... Fixed my car up..and now I am rolling. ...Less expensive than the rest...was worth every penny.

reviews.author: Hillary Walser-Smith
reviews.text: Great experience with Little T’s - great customer service, friendly, prompt, honest, fairly priced. Little T’s is now first on my call list in the area.
